rows.grounds: compound of śāstra and darśana; nominative singular masculine

items.question: Does scripture-vision count as manifestation rather than direct perception of full form?
premises: Paśus misled by scripture seek manifestation.
items.inference: Therefore scripture-vision is only manifestation, not direct perception of full form.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation between pratyakṣe and pūrṇarūpatā is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Scripture-vision is a manifestation; full form appears in direct perception.
